name: Joseph (Mary's husband)
title: Jesus' earthly father, carpenter from Nazareth
summary: Joseph was a righteous man of David's line, betrothed to Mary. When he learned that she was pregnant by the Holy Spirit, he took her as his wife after the angelic message and became Jesus' earthly father. He was a carpenter in Nazareth and led the family in flight to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Takes Mary as his wife
keyEvents.description: An angel appeared to Joseph in a dream and assured him that the child was conceived by the Holy Spirit, and he took Mary to be his wife.

keyEvents.title: Flight to Egypt
keyEvents.description: To save the child from Herod, Joseph took Mary and Jesus and fled to Egypt until Herod was dead.
